$comment: M7-14 (SPEC 12). One entry per row of docs/acceptance.md. `nodes` are pytest node ids run from backend/ by scripts/acceptance.py; a row with no nodes is not automatable and prints MANUAL with the runbook that carries the steps. Keep this file and docs/acceptance.md in the same order: tests/unit/test_docs_links.py fails the build when a row here is missing from the page.

rows.box: A new SAM.gov notice matching the internal profile appears in the app and in Slack within 60 minutes
rows.manual: Observe one real SAM.gov notice: portal posting time -> opportunities.created_at -> the bell, the email and the Slack post. Needs SAM_API_KEY and a deployed environment.

rows.box: A new CPPP or GeM tender matching an India test profile appears within 6 hours
rows.manual: docs/runbooks/india-testing.md, row "A new CPPP or GeM tender ... within 6 hours": three (portal time, ingest time, notify time) triples across CPPP, GeM and one GePNIC state on staging-in.

rows.box: Clicking Pursue produces a compliance matrix + full draft + bid/no-bid scorecard within 30 minutes, with page citations
rows.manual: The 30-minute wall clock is only observable against a real model: time one pipeline run end to end on a deployed environment and record the agent_runs row.

rows.box: Deadline reminders fire on the ladder in the user's time zone; calendar events created
rows.manual: Subscribe a real Google/Outlook calendar to the .ics feed and confirm the invite lands; part of the India pilot runs.

rows.box: DOCX/PDF/XLSX/ZIP exports open cleanly in Word, Acrobat and Excel
rows.manual: Open each of the four files in Microsoft Word, Adobe Acrobat and Microsoft Excel (not a viewer). The tests parse them with python-docx / pypdf / openpyxl, which proves well-formedness, not Office rendering.

rows.box: Cross-tenant test suite passes; audit log records every draft access
rows.manual: None. The harness enumerates app.openapi() and fails on any route without a factory, so a new route cannot skip the probe.

rows.box: India checklist above passes in staging-in
rows.manual: docs/runbooks/india-testing.md: 16 of its 30 rows are manual-pending (WhatsApp templates, SES Mumbai deliverability, Razorpay test payment, live residency, ISP latency, the two pilot bids). staging-in has never been deployed.

rows.box: Unit: every normalizer, scorer, date/time-zone function, eligibility rule; >= 85% line coverage on core/
rows.manual: Run `make test` -- the gate is `--cov=app/core --cov-fail-under=85`. Not re-run here because a coverage figure measured over a subset of the suite would be a lie.

rows.box: Adapter contract tests: recorded fixtures for each source (including a malformed page and a layout change) parse to the canonical schema
Live smoke (nightly): each adapter fetches >= 1 record from the real source; failure pages the admin channel
rows.manual: The nightly workflow has never run: it needs SAM_API_KEY and network egress, and SPEC 13.6 asks for three green nights in a row. `make smoke` exits 0 without touching the network unless BIDRADAR_LIVE=1.

rows.box: Integration: ingest -> match -> notify end-to-end on the local stack with Mailpit asserting the email
rows.manual: The rendered email is asserted in-process; the Mailpit leg (tests/integration/test_notify_email.py) skips when Mailpit is not reachable, so bring the compose stack up to exercise it.

rows.box: Tenant isolation: two tenants, every endpoint probed cross-tenant; any 200 with foreign data fails the build
Agent evals: 10 US + 10 India golden notices; recall >= 90%, precision >= 85%, zero fabricated facts, every requirement cites a page, eligibility exact match >= 90%
rows.manual: The bars are measured against replayed answers, not a live model (docs/evals.md). Run the set against the real model before launch.

rows.box: UI: Playwright flows for onboarding, search, pursue, review, export; axe accessibility check
rows.manual: Run with ACCEPTANCE_WITH_E2E=1 (it needs a Next dev server and Chromium). E2E_REQUIRE_BROWSER=1 makes a missing browser a failure instead of a skip.

rows.box: Load: 50k opportunities, 200 profiles scored in < 10 min; search p95 < 500 ms
rows.manual: The measured run and its extrapolation are in scripts/load/README.md. Not re-run here: `make load-full` needs its own database and about half an hour.
